longDescription: Traill is a children's story written during the mid-19th century that encapsulates the flora and fauna of the Canadian wilderness through the eyes of its main character, Lady Mary.

authorInfo.bio: Catharine Parr Strickland Traill (1802–1899) wrote Lady Mary and Her Nurse; Or, A Peep into the Canadian Forest. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
